description: cfd_3d_dambreak_amr with the level-0 V-cycle of the composite REEFAMR preconditioner on the reference device (N 16 2: one single-precision hierarchy of the whole level-0 grid for all ranks, the GPU kernels of reefmg_device_kernels.h in loops on the CPU, called by the host as a defect-correction step); the patch-local cycles on the CPU; the CFD pressure of 2 ranks; within 1e-3 of the CPU run (the level set of a dam break carries the solver tolerance into the interface)
covers: REEFMG device path (N 16) for the REEFAMR level 0, reference device
CFD AMR level-0 multigrid on the device
